g.text: • Bio narratives & skills text input [20..2000 chars]
Immutable intent event sent to ViewModel state machine.
Top-5 nearest neighbors, Euclidean distance & rates
Net take-home margin & domestic 15-tier fee deduction
Displays dynamic negotiation band & wage floor
• Manages coroutine lifecycle; auto-cancels on exit
• Catches network exceptions & maps to UI errors
Maintains validated inputs and model output across
Offloads JSON serialization, network transit, and
token retrieval away from Main UI thread.
Guarantees zero UI stutter or 60fps frame drops.
• Cryptographic keys never exposed to root OS
Zero-Trust: No unencrypted tokens ever written to disk.
• Coordinates token retrieval and API calls
• Transparently appends RS256 token on every call
• TLS 1.3 protocol validation & modern cipher suites
• Strict 10-second connect, read & write socket timeouts

svg.text: External Cloud Infrastructure Boundaries & Network Protocols:
• Identity provider issuing RS256 asymmetric JWTs
Client retrieves tokens via SDK; never manages private keys.
• Latency: Round-trip mobile network transit ~120 ms
Strict fail-closed enforcement on handshake or cert errors.
• Stateless ASGI execution • < 15 ms inference budget
Asynchronous Firestore audit logging off critical path.
